global_rules.goal_order: Order is irrelevant only when explicitly listed as independent.
global_rules.task_success: All required goals must be completed and final answer must pass separate semantic review.
global_rules.alternative_sequences: Accept every sequence explicitly listed for the task.
global_rules.secrets: Never include original credentials or live tokens in prompts, logs, or reports.
global_rules.latency_and_tokens: Count all model prompts, responses, tool-selection turns, and repair turns.
global_rules.mock_label: Every adapted task must remain labelled adapted_mock_task.

tasks.expected_output_review: Check that the answer reflects the returned scene devices.
